ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low internal contrast; predominantly low-intensity (dark grey/black) pixels across the visible surface with minimal high-intensity (white) regions present.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark grey pigmentation across both lobes; localized low-intensity (black) clusters at the lateral tips; discrete dark linear markings on the medial to distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch; central depression depth approximately 15% of total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the majority of the trailing edge; transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular jagged protrusions and rough textures at both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric upward concave sweep extending from the median notch toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of dark, roughly circular pixel groups concentrated on the lateral tips, characteristic of previous barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple unaligned dark linear disruptions; one prominent vertical scratch on the right lobe and several smaller diagonal rake-like marks on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jaggedness and 'fringing' at both lateral fluke tips, indicating localized tissue loss or persistent epibiont-related scarring.
